title_zh: 分工准备六个人的生日惊喜

scenario.goal_zh: 商定人数、食物和礼物以完成惊喜聚会准备

context_zh: 两位朋友为玛雅安排小型惊喜聚会，敲定食物和礼物并保持保密。
author: author-phase04-b

sentences.speaker: Benji
sentences.text: There will be six of us for Maya’s birthday. Can you keep the party a secret until she arrives?

sentences.speaker: Isla
sentences.text: Of course. Perhaps we should order pizza rather than try to cook while we hide the decorations.

sentences.speaker: Benji
sentences.text: Good idea. I will order three pizzas and collect the cake. Could you pick a gift from the art shop?

sentences.speaker: Isla
sentences.text: She asked for a sketchbook last week. I will get that and bring it in a plain bag.

sentences.speaker: Benji
sentences.text: Perfect. Come at six to help me set up. Maya will arrive at seven.

sentences.speaker: Isla
sentences.text: Six it is. I will tell the others to arrive before her too.
